clues: This city in Russia stands on a river, at the edge of the Ural hills. It lies on the road from the west of the land to the vast wilds of Siberia.
The low Ural hills block soft air from the west, so wild air rushes in. Cold air pours in from the far north, and plain air sweeps in from the wide lands to the east.
In the civil war that tore its land, the last royal house was killed in this city. That dark deed is a mark of its past that folk still tell of.
Some of the tallest towers in all of Russia now rise in this city. They grew up in a boom of wealth and folk in this age.
This city was one of the hosts of the World Cup in 2018. Fans from all round the world came here to watch the great games of ball.
